criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Transmission & Spread
categories.definition: Queries regarding how the virus spreads, including vectors, contagion methods, and high-risk locations or areas.

categories.name: Prevention & Precautions
categories.definition: Queries seeking advice on protective measures, safety guidelines, and best practices to avoid infection.

categories.name: Symptoms & Diagnosis
categories.definition: Queries regarding specific symptoms of COVID-19 or how to determine if one is infected.

categories.name: Treatments & Cures
categories.definition: Queries about medical treatments, cures, vaccines, or home remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Statistics & Data
categories.definition: Queries requesting specific numbers, rates, or quantitative data regarding cases, deaths, or testing.

categories.name: News & Updates
categories.definition: Queries requesting the latest news, current developments, or general status updates regarding the pandemic.

categories.name: Myths & Misinformation
categories.definition: Queries specifically referencing, seeking to verify, or asking about myths, hoaxes, or misconceptions regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel Advice
categories.definition: Queries seeking guidance or safety information regarding travel, transportation, or specific trip planning.

categories.name: Animals & Pets
categories.definition: Queries regarding the relationship between COVID-19 and animals, including transmission via pets and wildlife.

categories.name: Donations & Charity
categories.definition: Queries expressing a desire to donate money, goods, or find causes and organizations to support.

categories.name: Social Sharing
categories.definition: Queries requesting to share information, links, or content on social media or with friends and family.

categories.name: Greetings & Gratitude
categories.definition: Utterances consisting of salutations, greetings, or expressions of thanks and appreciation.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: Broad queries seeking general explanations, definitions, or comprehensive overviews of COVID-19.

categories.name: Personal Help
categories.definition: Queries where the user expresses personal distress or asks for direct assistance not covered by factual information categories.
